## Anime API

Anime is an image generation model by Community, available on the Venice API as `wai-Illustrious`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Anime (WAI) is WAI-Illustrious, a community anime checkpoint built on Illustrious XL, for anime illustration, including uncensored adult content. It accepts prompts of up to 1,500 characters.

### Anime API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wai-Illustrious` | Generate | Private | $0.01 / image |

### Anime specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Community |
| Released | Jan 11, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Prompt limit | 1,500 characters |

### How to use the Anime API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "wai-Illustrious"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wai-Illustrious",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette"
  }'
```
